description: Recipes ranked by how much of each the cook already has, with what's missing named on every one ("You have 7 of 9. Missing: lemon, parmesan."). Staples (salt, oil, sugar) are assumed. Uses the cook's saved pantry (update_pantry); signed out, or for "what if I had…", pass `pantry` as a list of ingredient names. `must_use` pins things that have to go in ("the chicken has to get used tonight"): recipes using them come first. Keywords, tags and max_minutes narrow it like search_recipes. Preferences (allergies, diet, avoid list) already apply. Read the cook the top few with the have/missing line and the url; a shopping list of just the missing items is the natural next step.

must_use.description: Ingredients the recipe has to use

pantry.description: Ingredient names to use instead of the saved pantry (signed out, or a what-if)

name: suggest_from_pantry
title: What can I make with what I have
